relations.name: reporting_borrower_payments_v1
relations.comment: One row per original payment receipt, including unposted states and all payment fields. Owner explicitly requested full details. Reference labels included; immutable IDs are for joins, not dashboard display. Amount received is not necessarily posted.
relations.view_definition:
SELECT p."Row ID" AS payment_id,
    p."Ref Borrower" AS borrower_id,
    p."Payment Date" AS payment_date,
    p."Status" AS status,
    p."Amount Received"::numeric AS amount_received,
    p."Payment Method" AS payment_method,
    p."Allocation Method" AS allocation_method,
    p."Planned Allocation Amount" AS planned_allocation_amount,
    p."Posted Amount" AS posted_amount,
    p."Created At" AS created_at,
    p."Processed At" AS processed_at,
    p."Bank Reference" AS bank_reference,
    p."Notes" AS notes,
    p."Created By" AS created_by,
    p."Ref Target Loan" AS target_loan_id,
    p."Ref Target Charge" AS target_charge_id,
    p."Ref Received By Cash Holder" AS received_holder_id,
    p."Ref Received By Cash Account" AS received_account_id,
    h."Holder Name" AS received_holder,
    a."Account Label" AS received_account,
    c."Charge Date" AS target_charge_date,
    c."Ref Loans" AS target_charge_loan_id
   FROM "Payments" p
     LEFT JOIN "Cash Holders" h ON h."Row ID" = p."Ref Received By Cash Holder"
     LEFT JOIN "Cash Accounts" a ON a."Row ID" = p."Ref Received By Cash Account"
     LEFT JOIN "Charges" c ON c."Row ID" = p."Ref Target Charge";

flyway.description: effective daily interest rate outstanding principal
automatic daily interest after principal payment
